behavior: An authenticated entered AUTO_RESULT in a saved frame identifies the source class being linked through AUTO_PUBLISH, AUTO_TRAIT or AUTO_INTERFACE. Validation restores the real caller scope before checking the selected loader and source-backed unpublished class.

Only ordinary fixed-name construction uses the new pending predicate. It raises the ordinary missing-class Error without invoking that class loader while the link is active; dependency fetching retains its existing pending predicate.
After failed linking unwinds, the saved marker is absent and a later ordinary NEW autoloads the name normally. An earlier eval function remains callable.

engine_route: Zend/zend_execute_API.c::zend_lookup_class_ex first checks the class table. An unlinked CE without ALLOW_UNLINKED or applicable ALLOW_NEARLY_LINKED flags returns NULL before the autoload path. zend_do_link_class in Zend/zend_inheritance.c exposes the dependency-link interval; ordinary ZEND_NEW in Zend/zend_vm_def.h reports the missing class.
